public_landing.hero_section: Deep blue gradient with warm yellow accent badge 'Homemade in Warje, Pune', headline highlighting authentic Pure Desi Ghee Maharashtrian Faral, quick stats (100% Homemade, Pure Ghee, Fast Delivery).
public_landing.category_tabs: Sweets (Besan Laddu, Dink Laddu, Rava Laddu, Karanji, Modak), Namkeen (Poha Chivda, Shankarpali, Bhajani Chakli, Sev), Healthy (Sugar-free Methi Laddu, Oats Laddu, Multi-grain Chivda).
public_landing.combo_offers: Cards for Rs 599, Rs 999, Rs 1499, Rs 1999 with explicit item list & weight limit breakdown, Add to Cart button.
public_landing.product_card: Includes weight selector (250g, 500g, 1kg), price auto-update, stock status badge ('Out of Stock' if weight stock is 0), data-testid attributes.
public_landing.cart_drawer: Slide-over drawer with item list, weight total (kg), delivery destination toggle (India vs Abroad), dynamic fee calculator (India: Rs 250/KG or Rs 250 flat under 1kg; Abroad: +Rs 450/KG), final total, Razorpay checkout button.
public_landing.laado_chat_widget: Floating bottom-right assistant avatar 'Laado'. Collects Name, Phone, Items required, Delivery Address. Answers pricing for Rs 599/999/1499/1999 combos. Anything else answers 'Aaiche Laado will call back for serving you...'. Saves lead with 2-3 line summary and label (Hot/Warm/Cold).
public_landing.order_feedback_and_testimonials: Form to submit feedback (Order ID, Phone, Ratings for Taste, Price, Nourishment, Comments). Published Testimonials carousel/grid at the bottom.

admin_dashboard.login_modal: Simple PIN or Password login (e.g., admin / admin123) for store owners.
admin_dashboard.overview_stats: Total Leads, Hot Leads this week, Total Orders, Revenue, Low Stock Alerts.
admin_dashboard.lead_table: Table with Hot (Rose badge), Warm (Amber badge), Cold (Sky badge) labels. Click row to open Lead Detail Modal with summary + 'Copy Ready WhatsApp Message' button in friendly Indian English.
admin_dashboard.product_stock_manager: Add/Edit products, update price per kg/250g, update available stock weight (in KG), publish/unpublish toggle.
admin_dashboard.testimonial_manager: Approve / Publish / Hide customer order feedback to show on public landing page.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js or .jsx) files only. Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn-1', data-testid='laado-chat-input', data-testid='checkout-razorpay-btn').

Implement the Laado Chat Widget faithfully with strict prompt rules: answers Rs 599, Rs 999, Rs 1499, Rs 1999 combo questions; responds 'Aaiche Laado will call back for serving you...' for unsupported queries; saves lead with Hot/Warm/Cold label and 2-3 line summary upon completing name/phone/items/address collection.
Implement dynamic delivery fee calculation: India delivery is Rs 250/KG (or Rs 250 for <1KG); Abroad delivery adds Rs 450/KG extra.
Razorpay test mode setup: load Razorpay SDK dynamically and trigger test payment workflow with success toast using Sonner.
Admin dashboard must allow managing stock weights. When stock hits 0, display 'Out of stock' badge on product cards and disable 'Add to Cart'.
Ensure dark deep blue theme (#0A0F1D background, #1E293B card surface) with warm golden yellow accents (#F59E0B / #FBBF24) and high contrast text readability everywhere.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts (located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or similar).
